notes: University of Adelaide assesses international applicants based on standard DHA 4-question framework (150 words max per answer) under their GS requirement guidelines. No custom structure override required.
sources: web:33 Adelaide Genuine Student Requirement - Visa Application Questions PDF

structure.instruction: Detail your ties to your home country, including family, community, employment, and economic circumstances.
Detail why you wish to study this specific course at Adelaide, including your understanding of program requirements and why you chose the University of Adelaide over other institutions.
Explain how completing this program will benefit your future career, including employment prospects and salary expectations in your home country.
Provide any other relevant details regarding your academic history, study gaps, or circumstances that support your application.
